target.statement: SRCC of the LPIPS-VGG baseline on the PIPAL test set (0.5947)

compute.basis: No code or data links are given; the PIPAL test split (25 reference images x 66 GAN-distorted images) is not publicly downloadable, and the LPIPS-VGG baseline would have to be re-implemented and evaluated on that hidden split.

blockers: No code or data links in the paper
